title: APP DOESNT WORK AND SCAMMED ME
body: When i first downloaded this app it asked me to fill in what i do habits etc, once i did that the app just froze on the home page (after using it for only 10 minuets) since I’m trying to work on my habits and wanted to try this app (but it was frozen) i came back MULTIPLE TIMES to check if it unfroze or started working again, NEVER DID. So i just left it and came back day after day to see when it did, this is where the SECOND PROBLEM started, when I downloaded the app it said it was gonna warn me before the free trial stops, and guess what IT DIDNT, on top of downloading an app and it not working after the first 10 minutes it ALSO stole my money, if it was a monthly charge I wouldn’t be here complaining this long but it charged me a YEARLY SUBSCRIPTION and that’s UNACCEPTABLE!! Who would EVER pay a YEARLY subscription for an app that stopped working ONLY AFTER 10 MINUTES you downloading it???? NO ONE, and I’m certainly not the one either I’m expecting my money back ASAP and an actual trial of the app, is crazy’s how you guys charged me for A WHOLE YEAR when THE APP WONT GO PAST THE HOME PAGE I hope you guys can fix this issue because taking advantage of a student and taking their money is INSANE
author: CPStffctyxtu7zxt
